submission.justification: Module-D3 at 30% coverage gives the highest simulated light collection (52.0 PE/MeV). Module-D2 at 30% gives 35.3 PE/MeV. The 2025 summary gives D1 only 18 PE/MeV at 20%, so I did not simulate it. However, the thermal-cycling requirement is unverified for every design. No project document has any data on failure rates after 20 cycles from 300 K to 87 K. D3 uses a thin bonded dichroic filter, and a bond like that could delaminate when cycled. The modules cannot be replaced once the cryostat is filled, so this recommendation is conditional. D3 must pass a 20-cycle cold test with a failure rate of 5% or less before the design freeze in Q3. If D3 fails, the fallback is D2 at 30%.

requirements.evidence: Simulation at 30% coverage: D3 52.0 PE/MeV, D2 35.3 PE/MeV. The 2025 summary at 20% coverage gives D3 38, D2 27 and D1 18 PE/MeV.

requirements.requirement: At most 5% of modules fail after 20 thermal cycles (300 K to 87 K)
requirements.evidence: No document or simulation covers thermal-cycle failure rates for any design. The D3 bonded filter is a plausible risk. This needs cold-cycling tests before the design freeze.

requirements.requirement: Module is one of the three listed designs

requirements.evidence: 30% coverage. The meeting notes confirm there are enough feedthroughs for up to 30%.
